title: Developer for Property Redevelopment and New Construction
short_description: RFQ for developers to redevelop land bank properties into housing and community projects.
project_scope: Establishment of a qualified pool of builders, developers, and development teams for redevelopment and new construction on properties acquired by the DeKalb Regional Land Bank Authority. Intended project types include affordable single-family housing, workforce housing, rehabilitation of existing residential structures, mixed-use or community-serving developments, and neighborhood-scale commercial or community facilities. The notice does not specify site sizes, building areas, number of units, or individual project budgets.
services: Design-build/developer services for property redevelopment, new residential construction, and rehabilitation/refurbishment of existing structures; participation through Statements of Qualifications for a renewable pool is not indicated, with a base period of 36.
relevance_explanation:
- General developer RFQ for a pool of future projects rather than a defined structural assignment.
- Focus is mainly residential redevelopment, rehabilitation, and community facilities, with no specific complex structure, bridge, roof, or special engineering challenge.
- No clear tender for structural design, bridge engineering, or specialist lightweight/long-span work.
- Framework-style qualified pool without technical specification reduces relevance for sbp.
- Could include mixed-use/community buildings, but scope is too broad and undefined for strong strategic fit.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the notice. The document describes a pool of future redevelopment and new construction projects, including affordable housing, workforce housing, rehabilitation, mixed-use, and community-serving facilities, but provides no quantities, floor areas, unit counts, or budgets, so no realistic project-wide estimate is possible.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided. This is an RFQ for developers/builders and development teams rather than a defined engineering design contract, so an sbp fee cannot be realistically derived from the available information.
references_qualifications: Qualified builders, developers, and development teams are invited to submit Statements of Qualifications to participate in redevelopment and construction of DRLBA properties. Specific minimum reference counts or technical qualification thresholds are not stated in the provided text.
